package nats

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
)

const (
	LearningPlannerEventsStream = "LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS"
	CoursePlanOutcomeQueue      = "ms-teacher-course-plan-outcome"
	CoursePlanOutcomeDurable    = "ms-teacher-course-plan-outcome-v1"
	coursePlanOutcomeSubject    = "course.plan.*"
	maximumCoursePlanEventBytes = 64 * 1024
	maximumCoursePlanCodeBytes  = 64
)

type coursePlanOutcomeEnvelope struct {
	EventID       string          `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string          `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string          `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string          `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string          `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    string          `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int             `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
}

type coursePlanOutcomeData struct {
	RequestID      string                     `json:"request_id"`
	GoalCode       string                     `json:"goal_code"`
	Status         string                     `json:"status"`
	ResultCode     string                     `json:"result_code"`
	CourseID       string                     `json:"course_id"`
	Reused         bool                       `json:"reused"`
	FailureCode    string                     `json:"failure_code"`
	Source         string                     `json:"source"`
	Reason         string                     `json:"reason"`
	AuditRefs      domain.CoursePlanAuditRefs `json:"audit_refs"`
	LearningPathID *string                    `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
}

var coursePlanOutcomeDataRequiredFields = []string{
	"request_id", "goal_code", "status", "result_code", "course_id", "reused",
	"failure_code", "source", "reason", "audit_refs",
}

func DecodeCoursePlanOutcome(payload []byte) (domain.CoursePlanOutcome, error) {
	if len(payload) == 0 || len(payload) > maximumCoursePlanEventBytes {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("course plan outcome payload is out of bounds")
	}
	var envelope coursePlanOutcomeEnvelope
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("decode course plan outcome: %w", err)
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.CoursePlanOutcomeSchemaV1 && envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.CoursePlanOutcomeSchemaV2 {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("unsupported course plan outcome schema version")
	}
	if !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(envelope.EventID) || !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(envelope.CorrelationID) ||
		!canonicalCoursePlanUUID(envelope.CausationID) || !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(envelope.StudentID) {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome envelope identity")
	}
	if envelope.EventType != domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted && envelope.EventType != domain.SubjectCoursePlanFailed {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome event type")
	}
	occurredAt, err := parseCoursePlanOccurredAt(envelope.OccurredAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, err
	}
	if len(envelope.Data) == 0 {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("course plan outcome data is required")
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(envelope.Data, &fields); err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("decode course plan outcome data: %w", err)
	}
	for _, field := range coursePlanOutcomeDataRequiredFields {
		value, exists := fields[field]
		if !exists || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("course plan outcome data field %q is required", field)
		}
	}
	var data coursePlanOutcomeData
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("decode course plan outcome data: %w", err)
	}
	if !validCoursePlanGoalCode(data.GoalCode) || !validCoursePlanResultCode(data.ResultCode) {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("course plan outcome code is out of bounds")
	}
	if data.Status != domain.CoursePlanStatusCompleted && data.Status != domain.CoursePlanStatusFailed {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome status")
	}
	if data.Status == domain.CoursePlanStatusCompleted && data.ResultCode == "" {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("completed course plan outcome result code is required")
	}
	if data.Source != domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher && data.Source != domain.CoursePlanSourceStudent && data.Source != domain.CoursePlanSourceSystem {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome source")
	}
	if data.Reason != "INITIAL" && data.Reason != "REPLAN" {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome reason")
	}
	if data.FailureCode != strings.TrimSpace(data.FailureCode) ||
		(data.Status == domain.CoursePlanStatusFailed && !validCoursePlanFailureCodeWire(data.FailureCode)) ||
		(data.Status == domain.CoursePlanStatusCompleted && data.FailureCode != "") {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome failure code")
	}
	if !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(data.RequestID) || (data.CourseID != "" && !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(data.CourseID)) ||
		(data.AuditRefs.DialogID != "" && !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(data.AuditRefs.DialogID)) ||
		(data.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID != "" && !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(data.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID)) ||
		(data.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID != "" && !canonicalCoursePlanUUID(data.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID)) {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome data identity")
	}
	pathValue, pathPresent := fields["learning_path_id"]
	if envelope.SchemaVersion == domain.CoursePlanOutcomeSchemaV1 && pathPresent {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("learning_path_id is not valid in course plan outcome schema v1")
	}
	if pathPresent && (data.LearningPathID == nil || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(pathValue), []byte("null")) ||
		*data.LearningPathID == "" || *data.LearningPathID != strings.TrimSpace(*data.LearningPathID) ||
		!canonicalCoursePlanUUID(*data.LearningPathID)) {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome learning_path_id")
	}
	if envelope.CorrelationID != data.RequestID {
		return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{}, errors.New("inconsistent course plan outcome envelope")
	}
	return domain.NormalizeCoursePlanOutcome(domain.CoursePlanOutcome{
		EventID: envelope.EventID, EventType: envelope.EventType, RequestID: data.RequestID,
		CausationID: envelope.CausationID, StudentID: envelope.StudentID, OccurredAt: occurredAt,
		LearningPathID: dereferenceCoursePlanPath(data.LearningPathID), Status: data.Status,
		ResultCode: data.ResultCode, CourseID: data.CourseID, Reused: data.Reused,
		FailureCode: data.FailureCode, Source: data.Source, Reason: data.Reason, AuditRefs: data.AuditRefs,
	})
}

func canonicalCoursePlanUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func parseCoursePlanOccurredAt(value string) (time.Time, error) {
	parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)
	if err != nil || parsed.Location() != time.UTC || parsed.Format(time.RFC3339Nano) != value {
		return time.Time{}, errors.New("invalid course plan outcome occurred_at")
	}
	return parsed, nil
}

func validCoursePlanGoalCode(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > maximumCoursePlanCodeBytes || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(character) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validCoursePlanResultCode(value string) bool {
	return validCoursePlanMachineCode(value, true, true)
}

func validCoursePlanFailureCodeWire(value string) bool {
	return validCoursePlanMachineCode(value, false, true)
}

func validCoursePlanMachineCode(value string, allowEmpty, uppercase bool) bool {
	if value == "" {
		return allowEmpty
	}
	if len(value) > maximumCoursePlanCodeBytes || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
		return false
	}
	for index := 0; index < len(value); index++ {
		character := value[index]
		if index == 0 && ((uppercase && (character < 'A' || character > 'Z')) ||
			(!uppercase && (character < 'a' || character > 'z') && (character < '0' || character > '9'))) {
			return false
		}
		if uppercase {
			if (character < 'A' || character > 'Z') && (character < '0' || character > '9') && character != '_' {
				return false
			}
		} else if (character < 'a' || character > 'z') && (character < '0' || character > '9') && character != '_' && character != '-' && character != '.' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func dereferenceCoursePlanPath(value *string) string {
	if value == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return *value
}

type CoursePlanOutcomeSubscriber struct {
	Conn       *natsgo.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanOutcome) (bool, error)
	Logger     *zap.Logger
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (subscriber CoursePlanOutcomeSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil || subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("course plan outcome subscriber connection and handler are required")
	}
	logger := subscriber.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = zap.NewNop()
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 30 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	jetStream, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = jetStream.QueueSubscribe(
		coursePlanOutcomeSubject,
		CoursePlanOutcomeQueue,
		func(message *natsgo.Msg) {
			outcome, decodeErr := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome(message.Data)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("terminate invalid course plan outcome", zap.Error(decodeErr))
				_ = message.Term()
				return
			}
			processed, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, outcome)
			if handleErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("retry course plan outcome", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
				_ = message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay)
				return
			}
			if ackErr := message.AckSync(); ackErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("ack course plan outcome", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Error(ackErr))
				return
			}
			logger.Debug("course plan outcome handled", zap.String("event_id", outcome.EventID), zap.Bool("processed", processed))
		},
		natsgo.BindStream(LearningPlannerEventsStream), natsgo.Durable(CoursePlanOutcomeDurable),
		natsgo.ManualAck(), natsgo.AckExplicit(), natsgo.DeliverAll(), natsgo.AckWait(ackWait),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return subscriber.Conn.FlushTimeout(5 * time.Second)
}
